brief:
The Quincy Institute has recommended a book focused on the Israel lobby in its seventh episode or publication addressing the subject. The independent think tank identified the work as essential reading for those seeking to understand the dynamics and operations of pro-Israel advocacy groups and their role in shaping foreign policy.

The recommendation comes as part of the institute's broader engagement with questions surrounding lobbying influence on U.S. Middle East policy. The Quincy Institute, which describes itself as dedicated to promoting ideas that move U.S. foreign policy away from endless wars, regularly produces analysis and editorial content examining major geopolitical actors and institutional power structures.
title: Quincy Institute recommends book examining Israel lobby influence
